name: RfcAcceptedSourceLifecycleProjection
input: LLD-04 accepted RFC field deltas already validated against source chronology, source-family precedence, vocabulary version, identity/adoption review and exact immutable source-evidence identities
transaction: one short shared LLD-01 UnitOfWork; LLD-04 staging/parsing/review completes before the write lock
steps: resolve exact surviving rfc_id and current projection inside the UnitOfWork
validate every evidence identity and accepted field delta through RfcSourceEvidenceProvider; LLD-03 never re-parses workbook text
apply only accepted usable field changes and preserve prior values for missing/unknown/unusable evidence according to the owning field contract
for Status require the LLD-04 versioned vocabulary classification and source authority; WFM provisional evidence cannot replace accepted Enhanced RFC authority
if current status is nonterminal/unknown and accepted current status becomes terminal_closed or terminal_cancelled allocate a new terminal_epoch_id
in the same transaction capture the exact terminal-cascade RFC/WFM membership and insert one pending proposal bound to the new epoch and exact status evidence

if accepted terminal-to-terminal correction changes status, preserve the same terminal epoch and current pending/executed cascade history; create no duplicate proposal during source acceptance. A still-pending proposal bound to different terminal status class/evidence is thereafter stale for execution and requires explicit RefreshRfcTerminalCascadeProposal before execution

if accepted high-risk terminal reversal changes current status to pre_implement or implement_eligible, require fresh reviewed reversal context bound to exact previous terminal evidence, clear the current terminal_epoch_id and supersede any still-pending proposal for that epoch; executed cascade history is never undone
increment current projection revision only for materially changed current accepted fields
insert command receipt/audit and commit atomically with the projection change and any new/superseded cascade proposal
terminal_scope: When the triggering RFC is subordinate, proposal RFC scope is that exact RFC. When it is parentless root/standalone, scope is the exact current root plus every direct subordinate. Provider inference never manufactures hierarchy.
wfm_scope: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant supplies only applicable active nonterminal WFM identities/revisions owned by the captured RFC scope. Local Tasks are excluded from membership merely because they reference an RFC. LLD-03 validates uniqueness/ownership and canonicalizes returned members according to SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_SCOPE_V1 before persistence/hash.
rules: accepted terminal evidence and local cascade execution are separate authoritative operations
terminal acceptance never mutates Task/Objective/Communication state
status omission/unknown values and workbook omission never clear lifecycle projection or create cascade authority
source correction preserves immutable evidence/history and never creates a replacement RFC identity
only a later accepted nonterminal reversal can make current RFC source presentation nonterminal again; it does not resurrect terminated WFM attempts
terminal-to-terminal correction never edits an existing proposal's captured terminal evidence or scope fingerprint in place
